decisions.title: Hibrit omurganın korunması
decisions.choice: Go labd; Rust Nautilus runner; one-shot Python statistics and independent auditor; no new exchange engine
decisions.risk: Native API and memory envelope remain unverified

decisions.title: JSON ve iki schema katmanı
decisions.choice: One canonical architecture JSON; Draft 2020-12 structural schemas; offline semantic validator; runtime schemas referenced by exact $defs
decisions.risk: Schema validation cannot prove scientific correctness

decisions.title: JCS sayı ve Unicode sözleşmesi
decisions.choice: JCS; NFC accepted-only text; all 64/128 bit exact coefficients and ns encoded as canonical decimal strings; finite feature f64 separately scoped
decisions.risk: Bitwise portable floating point is not promised

decisions.title: OOS tüketim kaydının ayrı sahibi
decisions.choice: Research SQLite and private sealed SQLite have distinct Unix owners and single writers; preaccess consumption receipt anchored independently; public mirror only signed evaluator output
decisions.risk: Root/admin compromise and preexisting LLM market knowledge remain outside preventive guarantee

decisions.title: Native uyumluluk kanıttan önce açılmaz
decisions.choice: RuntimeLock remains unresolved until native feasibility spike locks one source commit, checks hooks, chunk timers, delayed views and bounded state; no invented API calls
decisions.risk: Some capabilities may require upstream adapter extension; no fork or optimistic downgrade

decisions.title: Wallet ve attribution temelleri
decisions.choice: Physical venue basis is explicit weighted average or verified venue basis; virtual FIFO attribution is separate; physical+virtual total marked equity agree; isolated allocation and free-cash reservations cannot double-count
decisions.risk: Per-category realized PnL can differ between bases until flat

decisions.title: Sabit uç nokta ve test ayrıntısı
decisions.choice: Daily net marked PnL / initial capital; frozen circular stationary studentized bootstrap, HAC standard error, two IUT tests, Holm on conservative Monte Carlo upper p bounds
decisions.risk: Approximate dependent bootstrap validity and power require synthetic calibration

decisions.title: M1 ve M4 kapsam sınırı
decisions.choice: M1 certifies only synthetic/archived taker quote-trade linear-perpetual slice with verified funding; queue fixtures are independent miniature oracle tests, not passive production certification
decisions.risk: A taker slice cannot claim L2, queue, full liquidation or live fidelity

decisions.title: Terminal açık pozisyon değerlemesi
decisions.choice: At fold end use last valid mark and independently frozen executable close-cost provision; keep actual open position and unrealized PnL visible; no future fills or forced day flattening
decisions.risk: Missing terminal mark/depth makes endpoint unidentifiable

decisions.title: 64 byte fiziksel hedef ertelenir
decisions.choice: Logical schema lossless; Arrow typed batches first; compact binary 64-byte layout is optional measured cache revision, never the canonical information contract
decisions.risk: Row-size assumption must not hide atomic-message or identifier memory

decisions.title: Mühürlü hata ve restore davranışı
decisions.choice: Any experimental access burns window and cohort alpha; exact frozen retry stays inside same evaluation; leakage or unknown restore state requires fresh data; never release or refund after outcome
decisions.risk: Availability cost and conservative alpha consumption are deliberate

decisions.title: Ortak likidite yenileme kuralı
decisions.choice: Own consumption persists per level until a subsequent exogenous absolute depth update refreshes that level; never replenish on a timer or a trade replay already consumed; report model assumption
decisions.risk: Historical replenishment ignores endogenous own impact

decisions.title: Kontrol düzlemi iki taşıma
decisions.choice: Worker Unix socket framed JSON; localhost HTTP façade routes same operation IDs; separate evaluator-owned socket inaccessible to research uid; no network microservice
decisions.risk: Transport framing and role checks must be tested independently

decisions.title: Tier ve stop yetersizliğinde terfi
decisions.choice: Unknown historical margin rules block leveraged confirmation; generic mathematical isolated profile may support labeled synthetic fixtures only
decisions.risk: Today's exchange bracket cannot certify history

decisions.title: Canceled remainder miktar özdeşliği
decisions.choice: While working and uncanceled, accepted=filled+leaves; general revision invariant is accepted=filled+leaves+canceled, canceled remainder sets leaves=0. Replace emits new effective accepted quantity and retains prior revision evidence.
decisions.risk: Applying baseline shorthand to terminal canceled orders would either lose canceled quantity or keep phantom leaves

decisions.title: Custodial ve experimental OOS erişimi
decisions.choice: Deterministic normalization,qualityscan,checksum andbackup may perform logged custodial reads under isolated principal andfrozen nonfinancial policy; candidate execution or analytical feedback is experimental access and burns before first read. Unauthorized access always taints.
decisions.risk: Data-quality summaries can leak market stress; only frozen-policy whole-window eligibility may be released before consumption

requirements.title: Bilimsel karar
requirements.statement: A positive screening or run completion cannot produce a scientific edge label; INVALID, NO_EDGE, INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE and MODEL_UNIDENTIFIABLE remain distinct.

requirements.title: İki ekonomik hesap
requirements.statement: Compute trading PnL from actual fill prices with fees/funding once; keep LLM/data/compute/operations costs in a separate business ledger.

requirements.title: Sermaye koşulu
requirements.statement: Every strategy and control uses the same frozen capital, lot and leverage constraints; reject minimum-lot risk violations without changing capital.

requirements.title: Kaynak dürüstlüğü
requirements.statement: Publish performance budgets as unmeasured targets until hardware/corpus/repetitions and correctness evidence are present.

requirements.title: Native seçim kapısı
requirements.statement: No runtime lock or capability may be VERIFIED/CERTIFIED without exact source/toolchain hashes and native conformance evidence.

requirements.title: Parametre derlemesi
requirements.statement: A StrategySpec-only change triggers zero native or JIT compilations; operator changes require a trusted release and new certificates.

requirements.title: Unix sınırı
requirements.statement: Research, worker, audit and evaluator principals cannot mutate each other inputs, verifier binaries or private OOS registry.

requirements.title: Arbitrary code yasağı
requirements.statement: Sealed evaluator executes only certified operator sets and typed policies, never agent imports, scripts or arbitrary source modules.

requirements.title: Hash kimliği
requirements.statement: Run identity hashes a typed canonical object including code,data,policy,venue,split,seeds,environment,protocol and capital; attempt identity is separate.

requirements.title: Exact finans
requirements.statement: Price, qty, money and timestamps have explicit scales/units; checked wide arithmetic and venue rounding; overflow terminates the run.

requirements.title: Uyumluluk
requirements.statement: Reject unknown schema major, operator, capability or enum; schema versions and hash-bound artifacts cannot silently downgrade.

requirements.title: Ham veri
requirements.statement: Raw bytes remain immutable, checksummed and connected to normalized rows through raw hash/offset/session; corrections create new revisions.

requirements.title: PIT evren
requirements.statement: Use previous completed day information and bitemporal listing/trading/rule records; unverifiable delisted membership blocks generalized cross-sectional claims.

requirements.title: Veri acquisition
requirements.statement: Apply source-specific checksums, request weights, bounded retry and resume; archive actual endpoint/rule version and loss events.

requirements.title: Book bootstrap
requirements.statement: Buffer full atomic messages, anchor snapshot, discard u<lastUpdateId, require first U<=lastUpdateId<=u and later pu=prior u in Binance USD-M profile.

requirements.title: Atomic olay
requirements.statement: No strategy callback or matching uses a partially applied book message; source sequence overrides unsequenced timestamp tie shortcuts.

requirements.title: Gap açık risk
requirements.statement: A gap with open order or position marks the path unidentifiable; do not invent fills, stops or remove losing intervals.

requirements.title: Kalite sertifikası
requirements.statement: Each dataset revision has coverage, sequence gaps, counts, timestamp units, clocks, snapshots, conflicts, quarantines and rule provenance.

requirements.title: Availability
requirements.statement: Local features require available_ns<=decision_ns; funding final facts and forensic corrections cannot enter earlier policy views.

requirements.title: İki dünya
requirements.statement: Exchange truth and LocalView are separate; true fills/ACKs wake policy only on scheduled delivery; sampled future latency is never policy input.

requirements.title: Clock belirsizliği
requirements.statement: Record receive point, exchange offset and uncertainty; do not add feed latency twice or silently clamp negative delays.

requirements.title: Deterministik olay sırası
requirements.statement: Apply declared phases, source order and causal microsteps; a command caused by a trade cannot consume that trade's prior passive volume.

requirements.title: Bounded streaming
requirements.statement: Bound each input batch and timestamp group by decoded bytes; keep engine, open risk, timers, queue and indicators across file/chunk boundaries.

requirements.title: Execution state sınırı
requirements.statement: Durably export closed state before purge; never drop active lots/events or force-flat to pass RAM; stop with RESOURCE_LIMIT if open state grows beyond profile.

requirements.title: Feature state
requirements.statement: Use incremental bounded lookbacks; train-only fit, explicit warm-up/null semantics, shared DAG nodes and no historical pivot backfill.

requirements.title: DSL limit
requirements.statement: Default policy permits <=256 nodes, <=32 stateful operators and <=4 search parameters; larger models need a separately registered class.

requirements.title: Order revision miktarı
requirements.statement: Every working revision has accepted=filled+leaves; after cancellation accepted=filled+leaves+canceled; replaces record effective quantity and priority changes.

requirements.title: Order dedup
requirements.statement: Fill/event identity deduplicates retransmits; delayed acceptance cannot regress filled or terminal state.

requirements.title: Market yürütme
requirements.statement: Walk opposite observed depth at arrival, share available liquidity, apply exact fees, IOC/FOK/post-only and explicit unknown-depth remainder behavior.

requirements.title: Queue ön varsayımı
requirements.statement: At most one own active passive order per account/instrument/side/price in certified L2; unknown aggressor never fills both sides.

requirements.title: Queue stresleri
requirements.statement: Report risk-averse/base/calibrated models separately; fewer fills is not a monotone PnL lower bound.

requirements.title: Cancel race
requirements.statement: Cancel or replace pending is a local flag; until command arrival the original exchange order remains fillable.

requirements.title: Partial bracket
requirements.statement: Protect only filled quantity; bracket identity is account+instrument+epoch+group; native and client OCO have different race semantics.

requirements.title: Stop semantiği
requirements.statement: Stop trigger differs from execution; stop-market uses arrival latency/depth, stop-limit can remain unfilled; risk stop is not a liquidation guarantee.

requirements.title: Impact sınırı
requirements.statement: Record notional/depth and rolling participation; use 0.001 volume and 0.01 visible depth as screening assumptions, never proof of absent impact.

requirements.title: Funding pozisyon anı
requirements.statement: Settle signed -q*m*mark*rate against the epoch open at settlement precedence; late arrival is attributed to historical epoch without future mark join.

requirements.title: Funding tek uygulama
requirements.statement: Exactly one economics owner applies each settlement ID per account/epoch; native funding and external postings cannot both debit it.

requirements.title: Double entry
requirements.statement: Each currency transaction balances exact debits and credits; native cash, independently reconstructed cash and total marked equity reconcile with zero unexplained coefficient residual.

requirements.title: Reservation
requirements.statement: Free wallet less unallocated reservation is admission cash; isolated collateral cannot secure another symbol and notional is not a cash purchase for linear perp.

requirements.title: Tier tarihçesi
requirements.statement: Margin tier, deduction, rounding and liquidation precedence require a historical rule artifact; no current tier substitution in certified history.

requirements.title: Risk yeniden hesabı
requirements.statement: Recheck maintenance on mark, fee, funding, collateral/rule change and fills; liquidation can be triggered without price movement.

requirements.title: Risk state
requirements.statement: RUNNING may open risk; REDUCING only reduces, HALTED requires authorized reconciliation/reset; UTC loss and high-water counters survive restart.

requirements.title: Deployment varsayılanı
requirements.statement: Default export risk=0.005, open stop risk<=0.02, daily loss<=0.03, DD halt=0.10 and leverage<=3; changes need capital scope authorization.

requirements.title: Takvim split
requirements.statement: Use one calendar cut for all instruments; final 30 percent interval sealed; freeze split hash before selecting candidates.

requirements.title: Purge embargo
requirements.statement: Purge training samples whose inclusive information-label interval touches validation; use preregistered horizon+uncertainty gap and train-only fit/warmup.

requirements.title: Daily endpoint
requirements.statement: Use fixed UTC daily grid including zero-activity days and paired same-calendar controls; overlapping trades are not independent inferential units.

requirements.title: Random controls
requirements.statement: Freeze 1000 development seed IDs, eligibility/side strata and arithmetic mean daily control aggregation; do not force matching trade counts or count seeds as market histories.

requirements.title: IUT koşulu
requirements.statement: Compute separate one-sided economic-profit and matched-control tests and combine candidate p by max, with both economic deltas preregistered.

requirements.title: Dependent bootstrap
requirements.statement: Freeze block lengths, HAC lag, resample count and centering; resample aligned calendar blocks jointly across symbols and both endpoints.

requirements.title: Güç
requirements.statement: At least 50 usable temporal blocks is eligibility only; report MDE and dependent-power estimate; failing significance alone is not NO_EDGE.

requirements.title: Trial registry
requirements.statement: Reserve every attempted financial variant before accessing its outcome; exact crash retries keep trial identity and new code/policy selection changes reserve a new trial.

requirements.title: Sealed cohort
requirements.statement: Freeze <=8 candidates and all protocol/control/model hashes before first access; no candidate or endpoint replacement after any OOS read.

requirements.title: Holm ve alpha
requirements.statement: Allocate alpha_j=0.05/2^(j+1) for j>=0 across persistent program registry; step-down Holm includes every frozen candidate; no rename or project reset.

requirements.title: Monte Carlo
requirements.statement: B+1 >= max(10000,ceil(20*m/alpha_j)); cap B at 1e6 and block evaluations needing more; threshold-borderline PASS uses upper simultaneous MC bounds.

requirements.title: OOS tüketim
requirements.statement: Before an experimental sealed byte or metric is read, atomically spend cohort/window and alpha, sign a receipt and require independent anchor; retries cannot unspend it.

requirements.title: OOS contaminated
requirements.statement: Any unauthorized read, result leak, verifier change or unverifiable consumption restore taints the window; no confirmation on that interval again.

requirements.title: Karar kapsamı
requirements.statement: Every signed decision identifies capital, venue/data/model/profile, time interval and evidence; scientific PASS does not authorize live trading.

requirements.title: Gider bütçesi
requirements.statement: Stop new paid research reservations at monthly projected hard budget; accumulate provider actual usage idempotently and retain unbilled estimates.

requirements.title: Ajan family bütçesi
requirements.statement: Default family:16 variants,7200 CPU seconds and3 repair attempts per variant; separate data-prep budget and no reset by rename.

requirements.title: Rol bağımsızlığı
requirements.statement: Critic starts with clean context; auditor executes independently owned checker; agents cannot edit verifiers or approve their own mutable repair.

requirements.title: Özgünlük
requirements.statement: Persist AST and behavior similarity evidence without deleting attempted trials; director receives development evidence only.

requirements.title: Screen rescue
requirements.statement: Select one of each 10 valid L1 rejects by deterministic reservoir inside development; track rescues/cost and never select by OOS outcome.

requirements.title: Ledger otoritesi
requirements.statement: One writer commits immutable event plus operational projection in the same SQLite transaction; corrections append superseding events.

requirements.title: Artifact publish
requirements.statement: Write temp, validate/hash,fsync,atomic same-filesystem rename,directory fsync,then ledger commit; orphan cleanup never fabricates a completed package.

requirements.title: SQLite ve backup
requirements.statement: Use verified WAL-reset-fixed SQLite, FULL synchronous, coordinated checkpoint and short read transactions; consistent backup API and weekly restore exercise.

requirements.title: Anchor tehdidi
requirements.statement: Signed daily ledger anchor is tamper evidence beyond administrator trust; OOS spend has a stronger preaccess receipt anchor; hash chain alone is not immutable storage.

requirements.title: Memory rebuild
requirements.statement: FTS5 summaries and similarity caches are rebuildable ledger projections; every claim cites immutable events and cannot overwrite a negative result.

requirements.title: Üç oracle
requirements.statement: Separate hand-calculated fixtures, independently reconstructed accounting and observed-market calibration; same engine in two wrappers is not independent audit.

requirements.title: Fixture zorunluluğu
requirements.statement: Every certified capability binds applicable critical fixtures, binary, venue and corpus hashes; failed correctness blocks performance promotion.

requirements.title: Metamorphic parity
requirements.statement: Chunk/file partition and independent scheduling changes preserve canonical economic event hashes; freeze actions for fee monotonicity tests.

requirements.title: Null kalibrasyon
requirements.statement: Run 1000 independent full null research programs and injected-edge families; nominal5 percent requires95 percent binomial upper bound<=0.075.

requirements.title: Lease fence
requirements.statement: 30-second leases and5-second heartbeats use monotonic clock; reconcile PID/starttime/cgroup before retry and reject stale fencing generations.

requirements.title: İdempotent commit
requirements.statement: At-least-once dispatch is allowed; duplicate requests with same body return original receipt; conflicting body reusing key returns conflict.

requirements.title: RAM admission
requirements.statement: 4GiB allows one heavy worker,8GiB max two subject to actual memory/CPU/disk availability; child accounting includes charged cache/native pages.

requirements.title: Hard limits
requirements.statement: All children have cgroup memory,cpu,pids,fd,thread,scratch,stdout,wall limits; soft GOMEMLIMIT/DuckDB settings never substitute hard admission.

requirements.title: Disk koruması
requirements.statement: At75 percent reduce downloads/sweeps,85 percent GC only unpinned cache,90 percent stop new heavy work; protect sealed inputs and irreplaceable evidence.

requirements.title: Recovery
requirements.statement: After crash deterministically restart from immutable manifest; no full native state restore until checkpoint parity is separately certified.

requirements.title: Dashboard sınırı
requirements.statement: Bind localhost/SSH tunnel, read-only and operator roles, summarized SSE>=1second, no raw ticks or sealed results to researchers before release.

requirements.title: Override
requirements.statement: An operator may append an explicit override but never erase evaluator verdict or display it as scientific PASS.

requirements.title: Benchmark düzeni
requirements.statement: Same2vCPU reference class,2warmups and>=10timed repeats; report median,p90 and all failed attempts; cold cache claims require an actual cold experiment.

requirements.title: Task time
requirements.statement: Record hypothesis queue entry to audited decision commit DAG spans; include LLM,retry,build,prep,audit,report; walltime is critical path not summed CPU.

requirements.title: Challenger
requirements.statement: One funded challenger at a time; full semantics parity,>=2xmedian complete decision speed OR>=30percent total cost reduction,p90nonregression,4GiB and7daysoak.

requirements.title: Forward ayrımı
requirements.statement: Replay,shadow,testnet andlive are distinct immutable source labels; shadow does not validate actual passive fills andtestnet does not validate market economics.

requirements.title: Forward örnek
requirements.statement: Require>=200real small orders,>=50fills and>=10days plus scoped sample adequacy;95percent execution error budget<=0.25of preregistered edge.

requirements.title: Canlı reconciliation
requirements.statement: Unknown submission or reconnect state blocks new risk until orders,fills,balances,positions reconcile; live policy has no per-tick LLM call.

requirements.title: Signed export
requirements.statement: Export frozen strategy,locks,venue,risk,capital,binary,fixtures,rollback and authorization hashes; research roles cannot allocate live capital.

requirements.title: Örnek deney
requirements.statement: Example reversal uses exact144bar warmup,lagged96residualsd,ER24<=0.30,12variants and taker reference; any passive extension is a recorded child trial.

requirements.title: M1 minimum
requirements.statement: First end-to-end slice includes real scoped data,one instrument,native taker replay,exact accounting,ledger,manifest and independent audit; no required positive edge.

requirements.title: Milestone kanıtı
requirements.statement: Milestones exit only with applicable fixtures,negative-path tests,resource measurements,lineage and independent review; compilation alone is not completion.

requirements.title: Belirsizlik kaydı
requirements.statement: Record exact evidence required to close consequential unknowns; uncertain API/version/margin history stays blocked rather than inferred from docs.

requirements.title: Çift temsil
requirements.statement: Every normative object has stable id,human anchor and baseline references; schema,type,graph,traceability and negative mutant validation must pass for this spec package.

requirements.title: Sonsuz OOS yok
requirements.statement: Consumed holdout becomes development history only after release; new confirmation requires fresh embargoed time or truly untouched independent window.

requirements.title: Terminal kanıt
requirements.statement: No artificial daily flattening; terminal open inventory is separately marked and charged frozen closing-cost provision in endpoint; missing terminal data blocks inference.

requirements.title: Girdi sızıntı denetimi
requirements.statement: Trusted quality scanner may inspect sealed data without releasing profit-correlated quality summaries to research; windows and scanner rules freeze before cohort.

requirements.title: Uyumsuzluk kapsamı
requirements.statement: A failed optional capability blocks strategies requiring it and never silently replaces L2 by OHLC or increases fixture capital.

requirements.title: OOS backup monotonluğu
requirements.statement: Host restore cannot lower cohort index,alpha spent or consumed-window set; unknown anchor reconciliation enters WAITING_FRESH_OOS.

operators.semantics: finite exp; overflow => abstain/error by policy
parse finite decimal to binary64 once; conversion tied to environment
read only delivered field; missing or stale => null
lag p delivered completed observations; first p null
last window complete values arithmetic mean, no skip-null
last window complete values minimum; monotone deque
last window complete values maximum; monotone deque
Seed mean of first window complete observations; alpha=2/(window+1); then EMA=alpha*x+(1-alpha)*previous; gap resets warmup
sample sd sqrt(sum((x-mean)^2)/(window-1)); centered two-pass reference; stable rolling implementation must pass tolerance
Publish pivot at t-right only at decision time t after right complete bars; strict extrema; ties=>no pivot; no timestamp backwrite
exact order-stat linear interpolation h=(n-1)*p, lower=floor(h); no skipped nulls

physical_mapping.ns: Arrow uint64; SQLite INTEGER only when<=INT64_MAX; otherwise TEXT exact; Unix epoch ns range restricted to INT64_MAX
physical_mapping.price_qty: Arrow int64 coefficient + scale registry; not IEEE float
physical_mapping.money: Arrow decimal128(scale=currency exponent); integer coefficient JSON string
physical_mapping.ids: Arrow dictionary encoded UTF8 or fixed_size_binary32 for hashes

queue.base_cancel_ahead: cancel_qty*ahead/(ahead+behind) with frozen rounding, bounded by ahead; no trade/depth decrement double count

position.realized_basis_comparison: COMPARE_LIKE_BASIS_AND_TOTAL_EQUITY; realized categories may differ while open

verdicts.CANDIDATE_EDGE: G0..G4 pass; all frozen economic,control,fidelity and audit rules pass
verdicts.NO_EDGE: Frozen economic minimum not supported AND preregistered equivalence/power or upper CI <=minimum; narrow scope stated
verdicts.INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE: Wide CI,low power,nonsignificance,nonstationarity,MC budget or unresolved calibration without invalid implementation
verdicts.MODEL_UNIDENTIFIABLE: Required execution,mark,sequence or rule cannot be distinguished from data
verdicts.INFEASIBLE: Capital/venue/resource requirements cannot be met for declared profile

admission.active_work_rule: heavy_count<=profile.max_heavy_workers AND all numeric reservations fit

recovery.sqlite_transaction_without_artifact: IMPOSSIBLE_FOR_ACKNOWLEDGED_SUCCESS; detect and halt if storage loss

tests.title: Native feasibility and source lock
assertions: Pure Rust build without Python callback
Low-level streaming keeps open position,timer,funding and queue across input release
Independent LocalView prevents true fill callback and native cache access
All funding postings have one owner
If hooks insufficient return BLOCKED_BACKEND with exact missing API and resource trace; do not fork or invent method

tests.title: Data provenance and coverage
assertions: Every normalized row resolves raw hash/offset
Known-time and valid-time joins tested at exact boundaries
u/pu gaps,duplicates,conflicts and dropped captures preserved
UNIVERSE_UNVERIFIED blocks generalized cross-sectional claim
Checksum alone never sets complete=true

tests.title: Typed DAG and feature reference
assertions: All operator arity/types and params validated
No cycles,forward or centered op accepted
EMA48 seed and STD96(ddof1) previous window match independent reference at abs<=1e-12+1e-10*abs(reference)
No decision before144complete bars
Finite f64 reproducibility scoped to frozen environment
Threshold ties use strict entry and declared exit inequalities

tests.title: Independent cash and lot oracle
assertions: Integer coefficient residual exactly0
Physical basis and FIFO attribution reconcile total equity
Fees,funding and external transfers not double counted
Checker imports no native matching/accounting code
Mutation of fee sign,epoch,mark and reserve must fail

tests.title: Walk-forward and trial protocol
assertions: Calendar split shared across symbols
Sample interval purging catches equal-boundary overlap
Train-only fit and frozen control seeds
All12example variants reserve trials
No test-window retuning or forced trade-count equalization

tests.title: Native process and OOS isolation
assertions: Test actual Linux UIDs,mounts,socket peer credentials and private registry permissions
Worker no network and no sibling output access
Evaluator accepts only signed certified binaries/operator sets
OperatorOverride preserved separately and cannot forge scientific signature
Private audit and quality logs release only redacted manifest before cohort release

tests.title: Queue model differential and capacity
assertions: Exact fixtures only on shared semantic intersection
Policy-driven parity separately from action-tape parity
Unknown L2 cancellations and unknown aggressor remain assumptions
Trade/depth decrement does not double advance queue
Report model spread in fill,markout and net economics; no more-conservative-PnL ordering assumption

tests.title: Control interface conformance
assertions: Read exact4bytebigendian header before allocation
Reject frame>1MiB,invalidUTF8,unknown fields/version and expired deadlines
SO_PEERCRED principal authorization
Paginate<=200,SSE>=1second,disconnect resumes cursor or snapshot
Same idempotency key same semanticbody->same receipt; differentbody->conflict

tests.title: Crash and backup restore
assertions: Kill at every artifact commit boundary
Restore consistent backup and verify chain/manifests
No orphan PASS and no acknowledged local decision loss under fsync-capable local filesystem
OOS consumed-window set and alpha counters never roll back
Metadata package restore<=60minutes target measured separately fromrawdownload
